description: SA Climate Ready is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Department for Environment and Water, SA. SA Climate Ready is a set of downscaled climate projections data available for South Australia. Data is available for six climate variables (rainfall, temperature maximum, temperature minimum, areal potential evapotranspiration, solar radiation and vapour pressure deficit), using two emission scenarios (intermediate and high) through to 2100. Coverage is the states and territories, 2020 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies and climate adaptation planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
